# risks.md — NexCredit
## Generated by Scriptwall Compass on 2026-05-22

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|-----------|
| Borrower accepts offer but backend record is missing due to non-idempotent or fragile write path. | 🔴 High | Implement idempotent acceptance endpoint with request keys, atomic persistence, explicit retryable failures, and server-confirmed success contract. |
| Frontend progression diverges from backend workflow state, causing dead-ends and incorrect stage displays. | 🔴 High | Adopt backend-authoritative checkpoint state machine and enforce deterministic resume mapping on app start/re-entry. |
| Fallback/mock behavior leaks into production-critical paths. | 🟡 Medium | Add environment-gated fallback flags, status metadata, observability tags, and retirement checklist tied to provider readiness. |
| Unresolved provider decisions block full production integration milestones. | 🔴 High | Preserve adapter abstraction, keep one configurable provider path plus stable mock contract, and track decision deadlines with explicit owners. |
| No automated tests allow regressions in high-risk onboarding transitions. | 🔴 High | Introduce minimum critical-path integration tests for acceptance persistence, stage progression, and fallback envelopes before sprint closure. |
| PII/compliance exposure through incomplete masking or logging during fallback and debugging. | 🟡 Medium | Enforce PII masking/encryption policies and audit logging standards in every critical transition and error path. |
